verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.sm: UA faaiu e Iesu o ia upu uma ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia i ona soo,

verses.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.sm: Ua outou iloa a mavae aso e lua ona fai ai lea o le paseka, e tuuina atu ai le Atalii o le tagata ina ia faasatauroina.

verses.en: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.sm: O ona po ia ua faapotopoto ai le au faitaulaga sili, ma. le au tusiupu, ma toeaina o le nuu i le maota o le faitaulaga sili, e igoa ia Kaiafa;

verses.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
verses.sm: ua latou taupulepule i se mailei e mafai ai ona pue, ma fasioti ia Iesu.

verses.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.sm: A ua latou faapea ane, Aua le faia i le tausamiga, ina ne‘i faanunununu ai le nuu.

verses.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.sm: Sa i Petania lesti i le fale o Simona le lepela,

verses.en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
verses.sm: ona sau ai lea ia te ia o le fafine ma le fagu alapasa ua i ai le suāuu manogi tau tele, ona liligi ai lea e ia i lona ao a o taoto ia e taumafa.

verses.en: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
verses.sm: Ua iloa e ona soo, ona tiga ai lea o latou loto, ua latou faapea ane, Se a le mea ua faamāumau ai lena mea ?

verses.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.sm: auā ana faatauina lena suāuu manogi po ua tele sona tau, e foaiina atu ai i e matitiva.

verses.en: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.sm: A ua silafia e Iesu, oua faapea atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, Se a le mea ua outou faalavelave ai i le fafine ? auā o le mea lelei ua na faia ia te au nei.

verses.en: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.sm: Auā tou te nonofo pea ma e matitiva ; a o a‘u nei, tatou te le nonofo pea ma a‘u.

verses.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
verses.sm: Auā ua liligi e ia lenei suāuu manogi i lo‘u tino e fai ma faataimuaga o lo‘u tanuga.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o nuu uma i le lalolagi e tala‘iina atu i ai lenei tala lelei, e ta‘ua ai le mea ua faia e Lenei fafine, e faamanatu a‘i ia te ia.

verses.en: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o le tasi o le toasefulu ma le toalua, e igoa ia Iuta le Sekara, i le au faitaulaga sili,

verses.en: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Se a le mea tou te au mai ma‘u, ou te faalataina ai o ia ia te outou ? Ona latou avane ai lea ia te ia o tupe e tolugafulu.

verses.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.sm: Talu ai lea aso ua lamalama e ia se itu aso e faigofie ai ona faalataina o ia.

verses.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.sm: O le muai aso o areto e le faafefeteina ua o māi ai le au soo ia Iesu, ua faapea mai ia te ia, Po o fea le mea e te finagalo i ai matou te saunia e te taumafa ai le paseka?

verses.en: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o ia, Ina o atu ia i le aai i le tasi tagata, raa fai atu ia te ia, Ua fai mai le a‘oa‘o, ua latalata o‘u aso ; matou te fai ai le paseka ma o‘u soo i lou fale.

verses.en: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e ona soo e pei ona fetalai atu ai Iesu, ua saunia foi le paseka.

verses.en: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le afiafi, ona taoto ai lea o ia e taumafa faatasi ma le toasefulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.sm: O loo latou aai, ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia, E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e faalataina a‘u e so outou.

verses.en: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.sm: Ona latou matuā tiga ai lea, ua latou taitasi ma fai mai ia te ia, Le Alii e, o a‘u ea ?

verses.en: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o ia, ua faapea atu, O le fufui faatasi lona lima ma lo‘u i le tanoa, o ia lea na te faalataina a‘u.

verses.en: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.sm: E alu lava le Atalii o le tagata e pei ona tusia ia te ia ; a o le tagata na te faalataina le Atalii o le tagata oi talofa ia te ia! e lelei i lea tagata pe ana le fanau mai o ia.

verses.en: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Iuta le na faalataina ia, ua faapea mai, Rapi e, o a‘u ea? Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te ia, O lena lava.

verses.en: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.sm: O loo latou aai, a e tago Iesu i le areto, ua faafetai, ona tofitofi ai lea, ma avatu i le au soo, ua faapea atu, Ina tago ia, ina aai; o lo‘u tino lenei.

verses.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.sm: Ua tago foi o ia i le ipu, ua faafetai, ona avatu ai lea e ia ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, Ina inu ia outou uma i ai;

verses.en: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.sm: auā o loTi toto lenei, o le toto o le feagaiga fou, ua faamaligiina mo tagata e toatele e faamagalo a‘i agasala.

verses.en: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu foi ia te outou, ou te le toe inu lava i lenei fua o le vine, seia oo i lea aso ou te inu ai le uaina fou faatasi ma outou i le malo o lo‘u Tarnā.

verses.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona fai o a latou pese, ona latou o atu ai lea i le mauga o Olive.

verses.en: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu ia te i latou, E tausuai outou uma ona o a‘u i lenei lava po ; auā ua tusia, Ou te taia le leoleo mamoe, ona taapeape ai lea o le lafu mamoe.

verses.en: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.sm: A e a mavae lo‘u toe tu, ona ou muamua atu ai lea ia te outou i Kalilaia.

verses.en: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Peteru, ua faapea mai ia te ia, E ui lava ina tausuai o tagata uma ona o oe, ou te le tausuai lava a‘u.

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu ia te ia, E moni, ou te fai atu ia te oe, o lenei lava po, a o lei vivini moa, e te faafiti faatolu mai ai ia te au.

verses.en: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.sm: One fai mai ai lea o Peteru ia te ia, E ui ina tā oti lava faatasi ma oe, ou te le faafiti lava ia te oe. Ua faapea foi ona fai mai o le au soo uma lava.

verses.en: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.sm: Ona oo ai lea o Iesu faatasi ma i latou i le fanua ua igoa ia Ketesemane ; ua faapea atu foi o ia i le au seo, Ia outou nonofo iinei, seia ou alu atu iilā ou te tatalo.

verses.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.sm: Ua o ane o ia ma Peteru ma atalii o Sepetaio e toalua, ona tiga lea o ia ma atuatuvale.

verses.en: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, Ua matuā tiga lo‘u loto e oo i le oti; ia outou nonofo pea iinei, ma ia tatou mataala faatasi ma a‘u.

verses.en: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.sm: Ua maliu faaitiiti atu i luma, ona faapaū fao ai lea o ia ma tatalo, ua faapea atu, Lo‘u Tamā e, afai e mafai, ia ave ese lenei ipu ia te au; a e aua le faia lo‘u loto, a o lou finagalo.

verses.en: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.sm: Ona maliu ane lea o ia i ona soo, ua maua i latou o momoe, ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia Peteru, Pe faapena ea ona outou le lavā ona tatou mataala faatasi ma a‘u i le itu po e tasi?

verses.en: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.sm: Ia outou mataala ma tatalo, ina ne‘i oo mai le faaosoosoga ia te outou; ua manao i ai le loto, a o le tino ua vaivai. ua tatalo,

verses.en: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Lo‘u Tamā e, a le mafai ona ave ese o lenei ipu ia te au seia ou inu ai, ia faia lou finagalo.

verses.en: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.sm: Ona maliu ane ai lea o ia ua maua i latou ua toe momoe; auā ua maaa o latou laumata.

verses.en: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.sm: Ona tuua lea o i latou e ia, ua toe maliu ane, ua tatalo o le atu tolu lea, ua fetalai atu i le upu lava e tasi.

verses.en: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.sm: Ona maliu ane ai lea o ia i ona soo, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, Ina momoe pea ia, ma malolo ; faauta, ua latalata le itu po e faalataina ai le Atalii o le tagata i lima o tagata agasala.

verses.en: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.sm: Ina tutū ia, tatou o ; faauta, ua latalata mai o ia na te faalataina a;u.

verses.en: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.sm: Faauta, o loo fetalai o ia, a sau Iuta, o le tasi o le toasefulu ma le toalua, ua faatasi mai foi ma ia le motu o tagata e toatele, mai le au faitaulaga sili ma toeaina o le nuu, ua ia te i latou o pelu ma uatogi.

verses.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.sm: Na tuuina atu foi e le na faalataina o ia le faailoga ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, O le ou te sogi atu i ai, o ia lea ; ia outou pue ia te ia.

verses.en: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.sm: Ona sau loa lea o ia ia Iesu, ua faapea mai, Rapi e, si o‘u alofa; ona sogi ai lea o ia ia te ia.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu ia te ia, Sole, se a le mea ua e sau ai ? Ona latou o mai ai lea, ua tago atu o latou lima ia Iesu, ua latou pue ia te ia.

verses.en: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o le tasi o e na ia Iesu, ua tago ia i lana pelu, ua se‘i, ona ia taia lea o le auauna a le faitaulaga sili, ua tipiesea lona taliga.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, Ina toe sulu ia o lau pelu i lona faamoega; auā o i latou uma o e tago i le pelu, e oti i latou i le pelu.

verses.en: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.sm: Fa te oe ea ou te le mafaia ona aioi atu nei i lo‘u Tamā, ona aauina mai ai lea e ia ia te au o agelu e sili ona toatele i lekeona e sefulu ma le lua ?

verses.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.sm: Oua faapefea lea ona taunuu o Tusi, e tatau oua oo ia mea ?

verses.en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.sm: O lea itu po ua fetalai atu ai Iesu i le motu o tagata, Ua outou o mai ea ma pelu ma uatogi e pue mai ai ia te au, peiseai o se fao mea ? sa tatou nonofo ma outou i le malumalu, ma ou a‘oa‘o atu ai i aso fai soo, a e tou te lei pueina ai a‘u.

verses.en: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.sm: A ua oo ia mea uma ina ia taunuu ai Tusi a le au perofeta. Ona tuua ai lea o latou.

verses.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.sm: O e na pue ia Iesu ua latou ta‘ita‘i ia te ia ia Kaiafa le faitaulaga sili, na faapotopoto ai le au tusiupu ma toeaina.

verses.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.sm: A ua mulimuli mamao mai Peteru ia te ia, ua 00 i le maota o le faitaulaga sili, ua ulufale atu i ai, ua nofo foi o ia faatasi ma auauna, ia iloa ona iu.

verses.en: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.sm: A o le au faitaulaga sili, ma toeaina, ma le taupulega uma, ua latou saili ni e molimau pepelo ia Iesu ina ia latou fasioti ia te ia ;

verses.en: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.sm: a e lei maua ; e ui lava ina o mai molimau pepelo e toatele, a e lei maua lava. E mulimuli ane ua o mai molimau pepelo e toalua, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.sm: Na fai mai lenei tagata, Ou te mafaia ona lepeti o le malumalu o le Atua, ma ou toe faia i aso e tolu.

verses.en: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.sm: Ona tu ai lea i luga o le faitaulaga sili, ua faapea mai ia te ia, E leai ea sau tali ? Pe se a le mau a nei tagata ia te oe ?

verses.en: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.sm: A ua le fetalai Iesu. Ona fai mai ai lea o le faitaulaga sili, ua faapea mai ia te ia, Ou te fai atu ia te oe ia e tauto mai ia te i matou i le suafa o le Atua soifua, po o oe le Keriso, o le Alo 0 le Atua.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu ia te ia, O lea lava; ou te fai atu foi ia te outou, E mulimuli ane tou te iloa ai le Atalii o le tagata e nofo i le itu taumatau o le e ona le mana, e sau foi o ia i ao o le lagi.

verses.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.sm: Ona saeia ai lea e le faitaulaga sili ona lava ofu, ua faapea ane, Ua upu leaga o ia i le Atua; se a se toe aoga o molimau ia te i tatou ? faauta, ua outou faalogo nei i ana upu leaga i le Atua.

verses.en: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.sm: Pe ni a fa outou ? Ona latou tali mai ai lea, ua faapea mai. E tatau ona oti o ia..

verses.en: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.sm: Ona latou taufaifeanu ai lea i ona fofoga, ua taufaitu‘i foi ia te ia; ua taufaipo atu foi isi,

verses.en: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.sm: ua faapea mai, Keriso e, ina iite mai ia te i matou, po o ai na na fasia oe?

verses.en: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.sm: A o Peteru sa nofo o ia i fafo i le maota ; ona alu atu ai lea 0 le tasi auauna teine ia te ia, ua faapea atu,. O oe foi, sa oulua faatasi ma Iesu le Kalilaia.

verses.en: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.sm: Ona faafiti lea o ia i o latou luma atoa, ua faapea ane, Ou te le iloa le mea e te fai mai ai na.

verses.en: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.sm: Ua ulufafo ia i le faapaologa, ona teine, ua na fai atu i e ua i ai, O lenei tagata foi sa la faatasi ma Iesu le Nasareta.

verses.en: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.sm: Ona toe faafiti ai lea o ia ma le augani, Ou te lei iloa lea tagata.

verses.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.sm: Ua toe itiiti, ona o ane ai lea o e na tutū mai, ua faapea mai ia Peteru, E moni, o oe lava lo latou; auā ua iloa oe i lau gagana.

verses.en: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.sm: Ona augani ai lea o ia ma tauto, ua faapea atu, Ou te le iloa lava lea tagata. Ona vivini loa lea o moa.

verses.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.sm: Ona manatua lea e Peteru o le upu na fetalai atu ai Iesu ia te ia, E le vivini moa seia e faafiti faatolu mai ia te au. Ona ulufafo ai lea o ia, ua tagi lotulotu.
